calculation_handling.description: A laneway suite is allowed only on a lot whose rear or side lot line abuts a lane for at least 3.5 m, or with a cumulative 3.5 m along a side and rear lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 3.5 m length of lot line abutting the lane has no DSL input (lane-abutting length is not held); recorded as threshold_used_in_application. Keyed as a conditional PERMIT of the laneway suite building type; could also be read as UNUSUAL (an eligibility test).

units.disclosure: A laneway suite needs at least 3.5 m of the lot's rear or side lot line along a lane; we can tell whether a lot is on a lane but not how long that boundary is.

150.8.30.20(1).explanation: A laneway suite can only be built on a lot that has at least 3.5 m of its rear or side lot line (or a combined 3.5 m of both) along a public lane.
